target.supportedDevices: Apple Silicon Macs, MacBook Air M1 and newer

bundledComponents.name: portable-pty
bundledComponents.source: src-tauri/Cargo.toml dependencies.portable-pty (Rust native terminal module, compiled into the Tauri binary)

managedComponents.name: Node.js runtime
managedComponents.source: Official Node.js archive pinned by scripts/tauri/node-runtime.json and verified by exact size and SHA-256
managedComponents.firstInstall: Automatic verified bootstrap; no system or global Node lookup

managedComponents.name: Verboo CLI
managedComponents.firstInstall: Automatic signed bootstrap after managed Node is ready; no global install

externalRuntime.name: Git
externalRuntime.reason: Useful for repository-aware coding tasks, but not required to open, authenticate, or chat.

externalRuntime.name: Apple Command Line Tools
externalRuntime.reason: Useful when a project needs git/build tooling. The app must not install it automatically.

externalRuntime.name: System Node.js
externalRuntime.reason: The app uses its private managed runtime and leaves user-installed Node untouched.

externalRuntime.name: Global @verboo/code CLI
externalRuntime.reason: The app uses only its signed app-data CLI and leaves global CLI installations untouched.

blocksOn: missing bundled native modules required by the app
